description: This file defines a Swift class TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer that manages text-to-speech synthesis using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It includes methods to speak, stop, and handle speech events, and features a watchdog timer for timeouts.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class that provides speech synthesis capabilities, managing speech requests, cancellation, and timeouts.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops current speech and cancels ongoing operations.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Asynchronously speaks the provided text, with optional language and start callback.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on the input text length and language, to prevent speech hangs.
